text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — KV cache eviction rate spike on rope workers in us-west-2. Error budget at risk. Auto-escalation: paging oncall.

Samir (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing continuous-batching QPS jump and KV miss ratio > 85% on several NTK/YaRN instances. Initial hypothesis: long-context sliding-window prefetch holding large KV sets and causing fanout during compaction.

Mira: I can pull traces. Which model/route is hot?

Samir (oncall): route: /v1/generate/rope-ntk-longctx, model: redwood-rope-ntk-32k. 6 pods showing sustained read amplification. Logs: `rope.prefetch.window=32768` and `batch.max_tokens=2048` on these nodes.

Jordan: oof. Are these Dedicated or Hosted?

Samir (oncall): Hosted pools backed by dedicated GPU EC2. Affected shard ids: shard-17..20. Impact: elevated latency tail, some 503s when kv store hits eviction thrash. Customer-facing: a handful of interactive apps are seeing degraded latency.

Lee (sre): Can we throttle prefetch size or reduce continuous batch window quickly? We should avoid restarts if possible.

Ayna: We can flip a runtime flag to limit `prefetch_window` and reduce `continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens`. Patch ready. Suggest: `prefetch_window=8192` and `max_batch_tokens=1024` as a hotfix.

Samir (oncall): Approved. Rolling to the affected pools one shard at a time. I’ll push the flag via the runtime toggle.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy/rope-runtime-flags -> us-west-2 (shard-17..20)` started by Samir. CI checks passed.

Mira: grabbing some flame graphs and tail logs to confirm. If we see KV hit ratio drop after flip, we can keep.

Jordan: Noted customer impact: three active customers reported >2s tail latency; one reported intermittent failures. Creating support cases after mitigation.

Samir (oncall): Applied `prefetch_window=8192` to shard-18 and shard-19. Observing immediate drop in KV miss rate on shard-19 from 88% -> 42% within 60s. Latency p50 unchanged, p95 down from 1.9s -> 1.2s.

Lee (sre): Good. Keep shard-17/20 staged. We should also temporarily lower `continuous_batch.timeout_ms` to 20ms to reduce aggregation latency.

Ayna: Pushing `continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens=1024` and `continuous_batch.timeout_ms=20` now. ops-bot shows rollout to shards in progress.

ops-bot: Rollout status: shard-18 SUCCESS, shard-19 SUCCESS, shard-17 IN_PROGRESS, shard-20 PENDING.

Samir (oncall): shard-17 done. Metrics look stable. Noting one pod cycled due to config reload but no traffic loss.

Mira: After changes, KV miss rates across affected shards averaged 35% (was 82%). Token throughput decreased slightly but overall service latency improved.

Product-ops: Which customers were impacted? We need to notify support and coordinate messaging.

Jordan: I've opened ticket SUP-99823 for the high-latency cases; assigned to Customer Success. Sending IDs to product-ops DM.

Samir (oncall): Finalizing mitigation: sweep to remaining clusters and rollback plan prepared. If any shard regresses, we have a canary fallback to route traffic to lightweight model variant (rope-ntk-8k) for affected sessions.

Lee (sre): Let's also throttle prefetch concurrency: `prefetch.max_parallel=6` as a follow-up config change (not pushed in-hot to avoid extra restarts). Add to post-incident patch.

Ayna: Noted. I'll create an infra PR with tests for `prefetch_window` bounds and an automated regression test for continuous-batching perf cliffs.

Samir (oncall): Incident declared RESOLVED for immediate customer-facing impact at 1821003670. We'll keep monitoring for 2 hours. Postmortem: owner Samir, docs assigned to Ayna & Lee.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update — status=resolved, severity=high, start_ts=1821002468, resolved_ts=1821003670. Follow-up tasks: create postmortem, add automated alert for prefetch fanout > 10k keys, consider default prefetch_window cap.

Mira: Saved logs and flame graphs to the incident folder: `s3://redwood-incidents/1821002468/`.

Jordan: Thanks everyone — great rapid coordination. :thumbsup:

Samir (oncall): Will run a short blameless postmortem tomorrow. Please add any notes here.

Lee (sre): One quick note — we should add a synthetic that exercises long-context sliding window at scale to catch this in staging.

Ayna: Added to the backlog: INFRA-3721.

Samir (oncall): Closing thread for now. Will reopen if any regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
